text:
maria_sales: Quick one — ACME is asking for our SOC 2 report and a bridge/attestation so they can sign the contract this week. They also want a countersigned NDA before sharing some PII-sample files.

acme_poc: Hi Maria — we need the SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2025-12-31, and something that confirms no material changes since then (a bridge letter). NDA first, then report link is fine.

maria_sales: Thanks. Is the NDA standard here? Can legal push a one-off countersign this week?

jordan_legal: We can sign a standard mutual NDA. Two notes: 1) need to confirm which parties to sign for (ACME legal contact + subsidiaries?) 2) if they want redacted SOC 2, we can provide an excerpt + bridge letter. If they require full unredacted, we'll need an additional access mechanism and tracking.

leo_se: For the SOC 2 link, we have the report PDF in our secure share. If they need temporary access to the full report we can do an expiring S3 pre-signed URL or share via our auditor portal. Which does Legal prefer?

jordan_legal: Prefers expiring link with access logging. Also want to add a clause in the NDA: report may only be used for vendor risk review and must be returned/destroyed after 90 days.

sam_security: Small security note — bridge letters are fine for interim assurance but we should state the control period explicitly and call out any known scope changes. Also confirm no SOC 2 exceptions open. I can verify and attach a statement.

maria_sales: Timeline: ACME wants countersigned NDA by EOD tomorrow, report/bridge by Thursday. Can Legal + Sec move that fast?

jordan_legal: EOD tomorrow is tight but doable. I need the NDA template, sig block details for ACME, and confirmation on redaction policy. If they accept redacted report + bridge we'll be faster.

maria_sales: ACME prefers limited redaction. I'll ask them to confirm which fields they need redacted.

leo_se: Draft of suggested bridge language I usually use: ``Redwood Inference confirms that to the best of its knowledge, there have been no material changes to the systems and controls within the scope of the SOC 2 Type II report covering period 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, and no exceptions exist that would materially affect the report's findings as of 2026-02-15. This letter is provided solely for ACME's vendor risk assessment.`` Happy to paste into the NDA or email.

jordan_legal: That wording looks fine, will polish. Please also provide the auditor name and report date.

sam_security: Auditor: ClearLake Audit LLP, report date: 2026-01-31. I confirm no open exceptions as of 2026-02-14. Attaching short sec statement in the next message.

redwood-ops-bot: Deploy reminder — SOC sharing flow: use `s3://redwood-sec-artefacts/soc2/` with pre-signed URLs set to 7 days. Audit logs enabled.

maria_sales: OK I'll ping ACME for redaction details and sig block. Jordan — can you draft countersigned NDA with the bridge clause and the 90-day return clause? Sam — thanks for the verification. Goal: NDA signed by tomorrow lunchtime, report link + bridge by Thu COB.

acme_poc: Sounds good, will try to get redaction list by EOD. One more question: will you accept our vendor risk portal upload instead of an NDA? We can upload docs if you accept the portal terms.

jordan_legal: We typically prefer direct NDA for control over usage terms. If they insist on portal, we'll need to review their terms first. Maria, can you ask them to attach the portal terms for prior review?

maria_sales: Will do. Thanks all — I'll update thread as soon as ACME responds. :thumbsup:
